title: Guide
intro: Agentys is driven by voice and touch. No buttons to hunt for: speak, or tap the screen.
speakIntro: Just say the word, at any time:

reply.desc: dictate a reply to the current email

forward.desc: forward the email (it asks to whom)

archive.desc: file the email and move on

send.desc: after dictating: drafts and sends the reply

cancel.desc: cancel the current reply or an imminent send

repeat.desc: listen to the current email again

interrupt.gesture: Tap the screen while it reads
interrupt.desc: cuts the voice and opens the mic

soundsIntro: Agentys replaces spoken questions with short sounds:
